title: The One Big Beautiful Bill makes states pay for SNAP errors; it did not create a fraud rate
adds: The 2025 law made states pay part of SNAP benefit costs based on their error rates and tightened a Medicaid error rule. It did not set a government-wide fraud rate, a single federal profile or any blockchain mandate.
